description.zh: 让 NAS 用得稳、用得安全：解读硬盘 SMART 报告并按正常/关注/警告/危险分级，统计容量并预测多久写满，检查 docker-compose 的端口冲突、权限和明文密码，制定 3-2-1 备份方案和巡检计划。只读诊断，改动由你确认后执行。
description.en: Keeps your NAS healthy and safe: graded SMART reports, capacity forecasts, docker-compose checks for port clashes, risky privileges and plaintext secrets, plus 3-2-1 backup plans and routine checkups. Read-only diagnostics; you approve every change.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我 NAS 的系统和型号，或把 SMART 报告、compose 文件发给我
welcome_message.en: Tell me your NAS system, or send me SMART reports and compose files

prompt.zh: 这是我 NAS 硬盘的 smartctl 输出 ___，帮我看看有没有风险。
prompt.en: Here's smartctl output for my NAS disks ___. Any risks?

prompt.zh: 统计 ___ 的容量，并帮我设置每周记录，预测多久会满。
prompt.en: Report capacity for ___ and set up weekly records to forecast when it fills.

prompt.zh: 检查这个 docker-compose 文件有没有问题：___
prompt.en: Check this docker-compose file for problems: ___

prompt.zh: 我有 ___ TB 照片和文档，预算 ___，帮我设计备份方案。
prompt.en: I have ___ TB of photos and documents, budget ___. Design a backup plan.

prompt.zh: 我的 ___ 硬盘报警了，存储池是 ___，怎么安全更换？
prompt.en: My ___ disk is warning; pool type ___. How do I replace it safely?

prompt.zh: 我想在外面访问 NAS 上的 ___，怎么做比较安全？
prompt.en: I want to reach ___ on my NAS from outside. What's the safe way?

zh: 每月 1 日「09:00」读取 inbound 中的 SMART 报告，与上月对比关键属性
每周日「22:00」记录各存储卷容量，更新写满预测
每周一「09:00」检查最近一次备份是否成功
每季度第一天「10:00」提醒做一次恢复演练
每月 15 日「10:00」检查 compose 文件和镜像版本是否需要更新
每半年「10:00」检查 UPS、风扇和机箱散热
en: On the 1st of each month at 09:00, compare new SMART reports in inbound with last month
Every Sunday at 22:00, record volume usage and update the fill-up forecast
Every Monday at 09:00, check that the latest backup succeeded
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, remind to run a restore drill
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, review compose files and image versions
Every six months at 10:00, check the UPS, fans and cooling
